title.zh: AI discovers XRP Ledger flaw that could mint 18 trillion tokens and put $94 billion market at risk

current_state.zh: An AI-assisted security review uncovered a flaw in the XRP Ledger that, in a worst case, could allow the creation of 18 trillion tokens and threaten the roughly $94 billion XRP market.
